# FRESH Urban Forest Lab

> Agent-facing index for FRESH Urban Forest Lab. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Quick start](guides/quickstart.html): run the demo, build a dataset, and serve the app.
- [Web application](guides/web-app.html): 2D map, 3D scene, Change tab, scenario studio, assistant.
- [CLI](guides/cli.html): every command with examples.
- [Public data](guides/data.html): UBC, Vancouver, Metro Vancouver, LidarBC, and CanElevation sources and licences.

## Reference

- [Architecture](reference/architecture.html): layers, modules, contracts, and extension points.
- [Project status](reference/project-status.html): phases, release candidate, repository map, known gaps.
- [Research agenda](reference/research-agenda.html): P7-P11 shade, optimization, off-inventory canopy, and bird programme; novelty and evidence tiers.
- [Shade, species, water, and irrigation](reference/shade-and-species.html): marginal shade, solar method, species fit, water balance, irrigation cost, API, and limits.
- [Optimization and Pareto explorer](reference/optimization-and-pareto.html): Fresh Solutions scalarizations, parallel search, fuzzy archive, 3D solution space, API, and limits.
- [Off-inventory canopy](reference/off-inventory-canopy.html): LiDAR unmatched-tree candidates, land-class proxy, privacy rule, value of information, API, and limits.
- [Bird habitat and demography](reference/bird-habitat-and-demography.html): 3D canopy metrics, guild relative abundance, prior-driven lambda, Birds tab, and limits.
- [Integration and release](reference/integration-and-release.html): unified lab report, v0.3 release candidate, benchmark, and approval gates.
- [Data contracts](reference/data-contracts.html): dataset directory, tree record, scenario, scene payload.
- [Methods](reference/methods.html): cover, volume, growth, carbon, detection, change, and DSS assumptions.
- [Arbor method mining](reference/arbor-method-mining.html): the clean-room provenance policy and the point-cloud primitives borrowed from Arbor's published methods.
- [Change products](reference/change-products.html): observed change, masks, metrics, and the UBC/City products.
- [Validation and calibration](reference/validation-and-calibration.html): detection accuracy, field packets, allometry, growth gap.
- [Assistant](reference/assistant.html): the + Ask assistant, endpoints, context, and security boundary.
- [Deployment](reference/deployment.html): local, reverse proxy, Cloudflare/CWL, Pages.
- [Reproducibility](reference/reproducibility.html): provenance, commands, and what is tracked.
- [Testing](reference/testing.html): test layers, dashboard, browser checks.
- [Limitations](reference/limitations.html): what the prototype does not claim.
- [Software landscape](reference/software-landscape.html): what we borrowed, what we refused to copy, and why.
- [Session protocol](agents/session-protocol.html): the bounded agent workflow for this repository.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
